name: Singular Matrix Obfuscation
description: Replace the explicit geometric distance equation with a linear algebra constraint. The edge condition is enforced by requiring a 2x2 synchronization matrix constructed from the endpoint states to be singular. The determinant of this matrix evaluates to h_u * h_v - 2, which equals 0 if and only if one state is 1 and the other is 2. This hides the bipartite nature of the problem, forcing the model to solve the singularity condition to discover the h_u != h_v constraint before it can recognize the underlying graph coloring structure.
